title: ONYX HUB ( SKIN CHANGER)
features:
# ⚡ ONYX HUB — RIVALS

### 🎯 Combat & Aimbot

* Silent Aim — Redirects hitscan projectiles straight to target without snapping view.

* Camera Aimbot — Smooth locking onto nearest valid enemy.

* Custom Smoothness & FOV Slider — Fine-tune tracking speed and acquisition radius.

* Target Part Selector — Lock to Head, Torso, or Closest Part.

* Dynamic FOV Circle — Clean customizable FOV ring with active screen centering.

* Visibility & Wall Check — Prevents aiming at enemies obstructed by walls.

* Team Check — Ignores teammates in team-based modes.

---

### 👁️ Visuals & ESP

* Player 2D Boxes — Box ESP surrounding enemy models.

* Chams / Highlights — Full-body wallhack fill with customizable team & enemy colors.

* Health Bars & Text — Real-time HP display with color grading based on health percentage.

* Distance ESP — Exact distance in studs.

* Username & Display Name — Shows player names clearly overhead.

* Performance ESP Pooling — Zero FPS loss; billboards and highlights are pre-cached and updated at 10 Hz.

---

### 🔫 Weapon Tuning & Modifications

* Fast Melee — Overrides melee cooldown values directly in ItemLibrary for instant attacks.

* Fire Rate Modifier — Modifies ShootCooldown across all 55 weapon entries.

* Fast Equip — Zero equip delay when switching between weapons.

* Instant Burst — Removes burst fire delays.

* No Recoil & No Spread — Laser accuracy on automatic and single-fire weapons.

---

### 🏃 Movement & Player Misc

* WalkSpeed & Fly — Adjustable movement speed and fly hacks.

* Infinite Jump — Uncapped vertical mobility.

* Optimized NoClip — Move through walls using cached part sets (no per-frame overhead).

* Anti-Fling — Neutralizes collision pushes from enemies or exploits.

---

### 👕 Unlock All & Client Spoofing

* Universal Skin Changer — Unlocks every weapon skin in the game client-side without third-party downloads.

* Universal Wrap & Cosmetic Changer — Real-time equipment hooks directly linked into game remotes.

* Rank & Stats Spoofing — Spoof Level, Win Streak, and ELO rating locally on your player stats.

* Config Persistence — Equipped skins and settings save across game sessions.

---

### 🚀 Optimization & UI

* Modern WindUI Interface — Clean dark glass theme with draggable panels and smooth animations.

* Lag Reducer / No Smoke — Eliminates FPS drops by suppressing performance-heavy environmental particle effects.

* Single-Scheduler Engine — Driven by a consolidated scheduler rather than bloated RenderStepped connections.
